Directory server URL for LDAP authentication (B2-01). Empty (the default) disables LDAP: CONNECT falls back to the local user store only. Set to `ldap://host:port` or `ldaps://host:port` to enable directory-backed authentication at CONNECT (service bind, search, then bind as the entry DN). TLS verification is on by default for `ldaps://`; point `--ldap-ca-cert` at a PEM CA file for private directories [default: ""]
      --ldap-ca-cert <LDAP_CA_CERT>
